name: Litigation
overview: Scripture instructs believers to avoid litigation by seeking swift reconciliation with adversaries rather than resorting to secular courts, as seen in Matthew 5:25 and Luke 12:58. The apostle Paul challenges Christians in 1 Corinthians 6 to resolve disputes within the church, emphasizing that saints are called to judge even the world and angels, and therefore should be competent to handle matters of this life internally. This teaching underscores the priority of unity and godly judgment within the body of Christ over external legal proceedings.
